releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.3.0 (Build 67):
• Luna Chatbot Branding: Added official Luna icon across Mess Menu food logging & AI analysis badges
• Smart Dietary Nutrition: Fixed paneer biryani auto-resolution with vegetarian guard protection and preserved custom meal names
• Instant Interface Navigation: Core interfaces eager-loaded in memory for zero-latency, 100% reliable page switching without blank screens or chunk lags
• Fixed Sleep/Resume Freeze: Pure OLED black native canvas & instant compositor wake-up eliminating white screen flash and double-tap requirement
• Instant Cached Profile Avatar: 0ms profile photo rendering from local credentials, eliminating the "U" letter fallback flash
• Seamless Navigation Retracing: Reliable History-to-Home and deep route navigation without stuck animation transitions
